result.instructions: Tools for Solo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my last 20 invoices and show which ones are not paid yet."; "Show the line items and VAT of invoice 12-1-1."; "Which of my offers are still open?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Solo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run solo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run solo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run solo_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. solo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: solo_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the last 1000 invoices (račun) of the Solo account: id, number, date, gross total, status and status colour. Use solo_get_invoice with an id for full details. Solo API: GET /racun.

page.description: Page number (only needed when there are more than 1000 documents).

tools.name: solo_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with buyer, line items, taxes, totals, payment method, dates, IBAN, currency and a PDF link. The id is the long hash from solo_list_invoices. Solo API: GET /racun?id=.

tools.name: solo_get_invoice_status
tools.title: Get invoice status
tools.description: Get the payment status of one invoice: status code, colour and the payment date (datum_uplate, empty if unpaid). Solo API: GET /status?id=.

tools.name: solo_list_offers
tools.title: List offers
tools.description: List the last 1000 offers (ponuda) of the Solo account: id, number, date, gross total, status. Use solo_get_offer for full details. Solo API: GET /ponuda.

page.description: Page number (only needed when there are more than 1000 documents).

tools.name: solo_get_offer
tools.title: Get offer
tools.description: Get one offer with buyer, line items, taxes, totals, dates, currency and a PDF link. The id is the long hash from solo_list_offers. Solo API: GET /ponuda?id=.

tools.name: solo_get_offer_status
tools.title: Get offer status
tools.description: Get the status code and colour of one offer. Solo API: GET /status?id=.

tools.name: solo_list_catalog
tools.title: List catalog
tools.description: List the products and services in the Solo catalog: code (sifra), KPD code, description, unit, quantity, price, discount and tax rate. Solo API: GET /katalog.
